# Team architecture digest

No repository data was available — all repositories returned unreadable. There is nothing to analyze or digest.

To produce a useful architecture digest, I need at least one of:

- **Repository access** — file trees, manifests (`package.json`, `go.mod`, `pyproject.toml`, `Dockerfile`, etc.), or service configs
- **Manual input** — paste the relevant manifests or describe the services here
- **A working directory** — point me at a local checkout and I can explore it directly

Share any of those and I'll map it out.
